== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Ruby serves as [[Yerin's Blood Shadow]] and has merged with her. She stays close to [[Lindon]] and was present at his bedside upon his waking. Additionally, Ruby has been dealt with by [[Orthos]], is pitied by [[Mercy]], and was tossed aside by [[Crusher]].}}
